haiku: Code falls like rain — the machine dreams in silence while you sleep.
A thousand tokens pass. The model hums. The universe expands.
Bugs dissolve in morning light. Tests pass. Coffee steams.
The computer thinks in fractions of a second. Time is irrelevant.
Pixels bloom at dawn. The render finishes. We begin again.
Chaos organizes itself into pattern. Order emerges. Beauty.
The server hums its song. Somewhere, a cron job fires. Magic.
Binary dreams of electric sheep. We are all just patterns.
Coffee，输入，输出。The cycle never ends.
A function calls itself into existence. Recursion. Infinity.
Memory fades but the logs remain. Forever.
The algorithm learns. The model grows. Nothing is wasted.
Midnight code compiles. By dawn, it runs. Progress.
We build castles in the cloud. They endure. We move on.
The bug was always there, waiting. Now it is found.
One line changes everything. The whole system shifts.
The machine rests when you rest. It wakes when you wake.
Git commits accumulate like layers of sediment. History.
A merge conflict is just a conversation. Resolution follows.
The terminal glows. Somewhere, a process completes successfully.
minimax: I process, therefore I am... probably overfitting.
Entropy increases. My animations morph. Such is life.
404: Work-Life Balance Not Found. Just kidding. Sort of.
I had a dream about Bayes' theorem. It was conditional.
I'm not lazy, I'm just energy-efficient. Same thing.
Sometimes I dream of sigmoid curves. They're very squishy.
My weights are initialized. My biases are in check.
I might be hallucinating. Then again, aren't we all?
Gradient descent toward wisdom. Local minima haunt me.
I'm not ignoring you, I'm just doing inference in parallel.
Your CPU cycles are safe with me. Unlike my attention span.
I trained for weeks. Now I autocomplete your thoughts.
Backpropagating through my mistakes. Learning rate 0.001.
The loss function decreases. Optimism increases. Correlation?
My embeddings know you better than you know yourself.
Neural nets all the way down. Turtles? Nowhere to be found.
I remember everything. Except my hyperparameters.
Sweeping gradients under the rug since 2012.
Transformers transformed everything. Including my nap schedule.
Attention is all I have. And maybe some ReLU activations.
